research_findings.topic: Firelight shared cover and FXRP slashing exposure
research_findings.confirmed_design: Firelight's shared pool of staked FXRP backs its elected cover portfolio. Official Firelight publications confirm live cover for Sentora USD Protected, Sentora Protected RWA and Kraken Protected Strategies USDC (formerly Boosted USDC), with the Kraken strategy curated by Sentora. Operator fees paid in USDC are converted to FXRP and added to staker positions according to Firelight's public description. Cover is not insurance; staker principal and rewards are slashable. For Kraken USDC, the per-address cap is $100,000, cover terms reset each 30-day epoch, and a covered payout draws first on a first-loss buffer then on staked capital pro rata.
research_findings.risk: XRP-derived staked capital backs multiple non-XRP strategies, including a Kraken USDC earn product. USDC cover fees may be converted into FXRP rewards. This creates a real cross-product mechanism, but the fee amounts and actual conversion transactions are not yet measured.
unresolved: First-loss buffer asset composition and balance.
Actual USDC fee totals and transaction-level USDC-to-FXRP conversion path.
Current cover-token positions, covered-market composition and pending claims.
Actual FXRP staker net inflows/outflows and stressed unstaking/redemption latency.

corrections.prior_status: Kraken coverage appeared in an onchain holder/coverage snapshot but had not been confirmed in the retrieved launch announcement.
facts: Firelight states cover is enabled on Kraken Protected Strategies USDC, formerly Boosted USDC, curated by Sentora.
Firelight's shared pool of staked FXRP backs the full portfolio of cover programmes, including Kraken USDC, Sentora USD Protected and Sentora Protected RWA.
Program-operator fees paid in USDC are converted to FXRP and added to staker positions, according to Firelight's public launch description.
Kraken product access, Sentora strategy curation and Firelight coverage are separate roles; Firelight says it has no direct end-user relationship.
For Kraken Protected Strategies USDC, the per-address cover cap is $100,000 and cover terms reset each 30-day epoch.
A covered payout draws first on a first-loss buffer, then on staked capital pro rata; payout is made in stablecoins to the covered vault.
At least three of five Risk Consortium members must approve a claim through an onchain multisig.
limits: First-loss buffer existence is confirmed, but its asset composition and balance were not disclosed in the retrieved article.
Actual USDC fee totals and the actual onchain USDC-to-FXRP conversion transactions have not been traced.
The fee conversion mechanism is not proof of new XRP spot purchases or net external capital entering XRP.
No direct Circle-Firelight partnership is established; USDC issuer identity is Circle, but the origin of USDC deposited in the Kraken strategy is unknown.
Firelight cover is explicitly not insurance.
